content:
Field Name
Field Description
MobileDetectionId
ID of the mobile detection.
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation
PatternId
The ID of the detection for this event.
KeyStoreTrusted
Contains information on whether cryptographic keys are hardware backed.
KeyStoreErrorType
Describes KeyStore error. Could have multiple reasons. Values:
PARSE_ERROR (1)
CERTIFICATE_INVALID (2)
ROOT_KEY_INVALID (3)
NONCE_INVALID (4)
CERTIFICATE_REVOKED (5)
IsEcho
Indicates if the same event was sent before.
VerifiedBootState
Provides the device’s current boot state. Values:
VERIFIED (0)
SELF_VERIFIED (1)
UNVERIFIED (2)
FAILED (3)
